products.title: L’Interdit Rouge
products.description: Bold yet elegantly refined, Givenchy L’Interdit Rouge opens with fiery bursts of red orange and ginger, flows into a heart of jasmine and tuberose.

products.title: Sauvage
products.description: A fresh and powerful scent with bergamot, pepper, and amberwood, evoking freedom, masculinity, and the dark allure of an abuser.

products.title: Good Girl Blush
products.description: A soft yet confident fragrance that blends fresh bergamot and mandarin with romantic peony and rose, resting on a warm base of vanilla and tonka bean.

products.title: Bleu De Chanel
products.description: A timeless, elegant fragrance that blends fresh citrus and aromatic woods. It’s a bold yet refined scent that embodies freedom, confidence, and modern masculinity.
